name: Nan Daxuesheng de Richang
source:
A story-driven campus BL AVG with evolving bonds, key choices, growth, tension and hidden truths.

The story is set in an original modern fictional world, where sports and art have been elevated to unprecedented heights.

Football is more than just a competition — it is a stage for young people to chase their dreams and forge precious bonds.

You will step into the role of Chico Lian, a newly enrolled college student. Here, you will meet companions and mentors with vastly different personalities.

Train and compete alongside them, and stand together to face the upcoming challenges of the club.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473270/Our_campus_life/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/techjoygamestudio/bl-adventure-game-our-campus-life]Kickstarter[/url]]
